title: Pink Charcuterie Night
description: A pink girls' night spread: an acacia charcuterie board with pink-handled knives, a heart-shaped serving board, a blush gold-rim tray, pink faceted glasses, pink bird dipping bowls and scalloped napkins.
intro: Girls' night does not need a caterer. It needs one big board, something sparkly in a pretty glass and enough little bowls that nobody double dips. Make it pink and suddenly it is a party, not a Tuesday. Six finds, one Amazon list.

sections.heading: One big board and one heart
paragraphs: The acacia charcuterie board has a slide-out drawer that holds the pink-handled knives, with pink dishes to set around it. The heart-shaped board with its pink-handled cheese tools is the sweet little second board for berries and chocolate.

sections.heading: A tray for the drinks
paragraphs: A blush lacquered serving tray with a thin gold rim and cut-out handles carries four pink faceted stemless glasses. Fill them with something sparkling and carry the whole round at once.

sections.heading: Bird bowls and scalloped napkins
paragraphs: The pink bird-shaped dipping bowls are small enough for honey, jam and mustard and cute enough to be the favourite thing on the table. Pink scalloped gold-edge cocktail napkins finish it.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the acacia charcuterie board set, the heart-shaped board, the blush tray, the pink glasses, the bird dipping bowls and the napkins. The tables, candles, flowers, macarons, trunk, food and drinks in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
